description_en: Queries the list of time-series monitoring item products supported by cloud monitoring
description_zh: 查询云监控支持的时序类监控项产品列表
name: QueryProjectMeta

parameters.help_en:
Filter by labels, the format is `[{"name":"label name","value":"label value"},{"name":"label name","value":"label value"}]`.
Supported label names include product and groupFlag.
The value of the product label is the English name of the product. 
The groupFlag indicates whether the product supports application grouping, with a value of true or false
parameters.help_zh:
根据标签过滤，格式为`[{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"},{"name":"标签名","value":"标签值"}]`。
支持的标签名包括product、groupFlag。
product 标签值为产品英文名称。 
groupFlag含义为该产品是否支持应用分组，标签值为true或false
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: Maximum number of items per page, default is 30
parameters.name: page_size
